pr_title: Update Hello World Example with Up to Date Practices
pr_body:
Fixes #4620

Replaced var with const, 
added arrow functions, 
replaced deprecated function
pr_comments:
> Exampes checked in to the library repository need to actually function with the target Node.js version of the library (
> 
> https://github.com/expressjs/express/blob/28db2c2c5cf992c897d1fbbc6b119ee02fe32ab1/package.json#L83
> 
> ). You will find the CI will fail with these changes due to this.

Just removed the arrow function.
I think I may have just goofed myself. I switched back the arrow function. But just to clarify, did you mean to make all changes so that the example will work with Node version 0.10?

> @icepaq The CI test cases would still fail as ESLint defaults to ES5 syntax-checking and ES6 or above is not set as seen here:
> 
> https://github.com/expressjs/express/blob/28db2c2c5cf992c897d1fbbc6b119ee02fe32ab1/.eslintrc.yml#L1-L8

Looks like in that case the only change in this PR is changing the deprecated module. Look like in the [docs](https://nodejs.org/api/modules.html#modules_module_children) module.children was added in 1.16 so that shouldn't create any issues.

This PR is being closed due to my changes being incompatible with ES5. 

I will shortly open a new issue and PR addressing the deprecated module.

issue_context.title: Hello World Example is Outdated
issue_context.body:
The Hello World example was last updated 7 years ago. A few styling changes should be made. This is usually the first example new express users look at so it should be up to date. 

I will issue a new PR with the following changes:

Replaced `var` with `const`, 
Replaced `function(req, res)` with `(req, res) =>`, 
Replaced `if(!module.parent)` with `if(module.children`). I'm not an expert with node. I made this last change simply because the docs said module.parent was deprecated.

This is my first PR in a large repository so please let me know if I made any mistakes. Cheers!
comments: Our hello world example (http://expressjs.com/en/starter/hello-world.html) already has these changes made 👍

review_comments: I'm not sure this change is correct looking at the docs (even though it happens to work for our tests). The current conditional tests to see if this file was required by another module or not (desired test), but this change instead checks if any module require by this module was the first time is was required or not. That seems like it would be a side effecr, as this only works if express was required prior to requiring thispdule, which is not the purpose of the test here.

This is a bit out of my knowledge now. I originally didn't intend on changing that line, however, I did because the docs showed that `module.parent` was deprecated. I'll let you and Aravind decide the best solution for this.
Gotcha. If that is the case, it seems like this PR should then be closed and one of us will open a new one with the appropriate change.
Sounds good. If you'd like me to do that, I can. Otherwise have a nice day!
